name: How long does it take to see results from AEO efforts for a restoration business?
description: AEO results can appear relatively quickly, potentially within weeks to a few months, as specific, well-structured answers are readily processed by AI models.

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for seeing AEO results can vary, but generally, specific optimizations aimed at answer engines may show impact faster than broad SEO campaigns. Because AEO focuses on providing direct answers, if your content is well-structured and directly addresses user intent, it can be picked up relatively quickly by AI models. Initial improvements in visibility, especially for highly specific questions, might be observed within a few weeks to a couple of months, with ongoing refinement leading to sustained gains.
